summary: Booz Allen Hamilton Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corp., issued $700M of 5.375% Senior Notes due 2030 and $500M of 5.900% Senior Notes due 2034 under an existing base indenture supplemented on August 4, 2026. The notes are guaranteed by the parent on an unsecured basis. Proceeds use is not stated; the sale closed on August 4, 2026. This is a routine debt financing under an effective shelf registration, not a special situation.
